Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You recognize the instant from your dream and call the warning before it is too late.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
An ally within 3 squares before it makes a declared roll.
Duration
The triggering roll and any immediately granted movement.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

If it hears your warning, grant 2 Boons to that roll. If it achieves Strong, it may move 1 square without provoking immediately afterward. Only rolls using an attribute; no inventory or wound rolls and no change after dice land.
